sv.title: Hushållen väntar sig stigande priser i EU
sv.summary: Euroområdets inflationstakt väntas vara 3,5 procent om ett år, 3,0 procent om tre år och 2,5 procent om fem år.

en.title: Households expect rising prices in the EU
en.summary: The euro area's inflation rate is expected to be 3.5 percent in one year, 3.0 percent in three years and 2.5 percent in five years.
